transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I'm coming in today because I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad for the past seven months. I just feel completely drained of all my energy, and it's been really hard to even get through the day.
Have you experienced any periods of elevated mood, irritability, or increased energy over the past seven months, even if they were brief?

Yes, before this depression started, I had a period of about four months where my mood was incredibly high and I had endless energy. During that time, I was also extremely irritable and would snap at people over the smallest things.

During your current depressive episode or the period of high mood and irritability, have you experienced any unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others couldn't, or held any beliefs that seemed real to you but might not be based in reality?

Yes, during that high-energy period, I heard voices and had some really intense, strange beliefs that felt completely real at the time. However, those experiences only happened during those four months when my mood was so high and irritable. Since I've been depressed, I haven't experienced anything like that at all.

Can you clarify if the voices and strange beliefs you experienced during the high-energy period occurred only when your mood was at its peak, or were they present throughout the entire four-month period, even when your mood might have been less intense?

They were present off and on throughout that entire four-month high-energy period, not just at the very peak. But they definitely only happened during those four months and never at any other time, especially not since I've been depressed.
Did you have any periods of at least two weeks where you experienced the strange beliefs or heard voices without also having a high or irritable mood during the entire four-month period?
No, I never experienced those things on their own. The voices and strange beliefs only happened when my mood was elevated and irritable. They never occurred during any period when my mood was normal.
Can you tell me more about your current depressive episode, such as how it started and if you've had any periods of significant improvement or worsening of symptoms over the past seven months?

It started very gradually, like a heavy fog slowly creeping in, and it has been a constant weight with no real improvement over these past seven months. I just feel this deep emptiness and have absolutely no motivation to do anything. I'm also dealing with a constant, heavy fatigue that never seems to lift, no matter how much I rest.

Did you have any periods of at least two weeks where you experienced the strange beliefs or heard voices without also having a high or irritable mood at any point in your life, not just limited to the four-month period you mentioned earlier?

No, I have never experienced those strange beliefs or voices on their own at any point in my life. They only ever happened during the periods when I was feeling extremely high, energetic, or irritable. Outside of those times, I've never had anything like that happen.

So, just to confirm, you've only experienced psychotic symptoms, such as hearing voices or having strange beliefs, when you were also experiencing episodes of elevated mood, irritability, or increased energy, and never at any other time in your life, is that correct?

Yes, that is completely correct. Those strange beliefs and hearing voices only occurred when I was in that high-energy, irritable state. I've never experienced anything like that when my mood was normal or during this depression.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you had significant depressive or manic symptoms, but no psychotic symptoms, or vice versa, at any point in your life?

Yes, during this current seven-month depression, I haven't experienced any voices or strange beliefs at all. Those unusual experiences only happened during my four-month high period, so this entire depressive episode has been completely free of them.

It seems that your psychotic symptoms have only occurred in conjunction with your manic episodes, and you've had a distinct period of depression without psychotic symptoms. This pattern suggests a strong likelihood of Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features, as the psychotic symptoms appear to be closely tied to your mood episodes. Is there anything else you'd like to add or discuss before we summarize your diagnosis and consider treatment options?

Yes, that is exactly how it has been—the strange experiences only happened during my high-energy phase, while this depression has just been deep emptiness and fatigue without any of those symptoms. I agree with your summary and would really like to discuss the diagnosis and what treatment options are available to help me.
